## User problem

What user outcome is missing or failing?

## Change

What behavior, documentation, package, or public surface changed?

## Verification

List the exact commands and live checks performed.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] User guide reflects the changed behavior
- [ ] Examples use synthetic data
- [ ] Catalog and manifest agree
- [ ] Public links were checked when changed
- [ ] Privacy and credential scans pass
- [ ] Changelog entry added for a material public change

## Risk and rollback

What could break? How can the change be reversed safely?

## Unverified

List anything that was not tested. Write `None` only when every relevant path was verified.
